name: Technische Universität Berlin
feeMethod: Regular degrees have no tuition, so the calculator uses only the semester fee; a few continuing-education or fee-charging master's set their own programme total, which is spread over the programme's years.
description: Technische Universität Berlin is a public technical university in Berlin with about 35,000 students, strong in engineering, computer science and natural sciences. It is part of the Berlin University Alliance funded under Germany's Excellence Strategy.
whyIncluded: TU Berlin is a member of the Berlin University Alliance, which has a strategic partnership with the National University of Singapore, and nearly 30% of its students come from abroad.

livingCosts.summary: TU Berlin's own estimate of a student's monthly costs in Berlin. Local transport is covered by the semester ticket in the semester fee. Excludes health insurance and fees.
livingCosts.notes: TU Berlin exchange-studies FAQ: accommodation EUR 350-650 (midpoint 500), food 150, clothing 60, books/study materials 40, other 40 (personal = 140), health insurance 120-130 (excluded); public transport included in the semester ticket; 'approx. EUR 900', with 'From January 2023, this will be EUR 934 per month' (visa requirement), hence year 2023. Page undated otherwise. Fix 2026-10-15: re-read https://www.tu.berlin/en/international/students-1/international-students/exchange-studies-at-tu-berlin/administrative-matters/faqs-and-timeline on 2026-10-15; the exchange-studies FAQ still gives the same monthly estimate (accommodation EUR 350-650, food 150, clothing 60, books 40, other 40, health insurance 120-130 excluded, public transport in the semester ticket, 'approx. EUR 900', visa proof EUR 934 from January 2023) and TU Berlin's former 'financing your studies' pages now return 404, so the lines and year are unchanged.

programmes.name: Computer Science (Informatik) B.Sc.
programmes.feeBasis: TU Berlin charges no tuition for any degree; the figure is just the winter 2026/27 semester fee of EUR 379.06 x 2 semesters, the same for every programme.
programmes.summary: No tuition. The figure is only the compulsory semester fee (administration, student services and a Germany-wide transport ticket) for 2026-27.
programmes.notes: No tuition fees at TU Berlin ('There are no tuition fees to pay at TU Berlin. The only exceptions to this are continuing education master's programs', https://www.tu.berlin/en/studying/organizing-your-studies/financing-your-studies). Compulsory fees = semester fee for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 379.06 per semester x2 = 758.12: administration fee 50 + student body 14.56 + studierendenWERK 85 + Semesterticket (Deutschlandsemesterticket) 226.80 + social fund 2.70 (TU 'Semester fees' page). History: TU 'Semester fees of previous semesters' page: WS 2025/26 EUR 360.49 (x2 = 720.98); WS 2024/25 EUR 299.35 = 63 + 50 + 9.95 + 176.40 (x2 = 598.70). Winter rate x2 follows the convention used for other Berlin universities in this dataset. Programme page https://www.tu.berlin/en/studying/study-programs/all-programs-offered/study-course/computer-science-b-sc: 6 semesters, German-taught; admission-restricted.

programmes.name: Energy Management MBA
programmes.feeBasis: This fee-charging TU Berlin master's publishes one total of EUR 19,800; the calculator spreads it over 1.5 years (EUR 13,200 a year) and adds the TU semester fee.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for the 18-month programme starting October 2026 (EUR 19,800 in total), plus the TU Berlin semester fee.
programmes.notes: Continuing-education MBA run for TU Berlin by TU Berlin Services GmbH (programme site linked from TU's programme page https://www.tu.berlin/en/studying/study-programs/all-programs-offered/study-course/energy-management-m-ba). Programme site: total tuition EUR 19,800, 'Program starts Oct 2026', 3 semesters, English-taught; semester fee payable on top (links to the TU semester-fees page). annualTuition = 19,800 / 1.5 years. Compulsory fees = semester fee for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 379.06 per semester x2 = 758.12: administration fee 50 + student body 14.56 + studierendenWERK 85 + Semesterticket (Deutschlandsemesterticket) 226.80 + social fund 2.70 (TU 'Semester fees' page). History: TU 'Semester fees of previous semesters' page: WS 2025/26 EUR 360.49 (x2 = 720.98); WS 2024/25 EUR 299.35 = 63 + 50 + 9.95 + 176.40 (x2 = 598.70). Winter rate x2 follows the convention used for other Berlin universities in this dataset. No earlier-intake tuition found (site not archived). Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): October 2024 intake: EUR 19,800 total / 1.5 years = 13,200. Compulsory fees = WS 2024/25 TU semester fee 299.35 x2 (the convention given in the notes). October 2025 intake: EUR 19,800 total / 1.5 = 13,200. Compulsory fees = WS 2025/26 TU semester fee 360.49 x2.

programmes.name: Global Production Engineering M.Sc.
programmes.feeBasis: This fee-charging TU Berlin master's publishes one total of EUR 15,500; the calculator spreads it over 2 years (EUR 7,750 a year) and adds the TU semester fee.
programmes.summary: Yearly tuition for this two-year fee-charging master's (EUR 15,500 in total), plus the TU Berlin semester fee.
programmes.notes: GPE programme information page: '15.500EUR for the entire study program (1 installment at 6.200EUR & 3 installments at 3.100EUR)', 4 semesters, English-taught, October start, plus about EUR 320 per semester semester fee. The page carries no year label; read 2026-10-13 as the current programme fee, treated as the 2026 intake. annualTuition = 15,500 / 2. Compulsory fees use the exact TU semester fee. Compulsory fees = semester fee for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 379.06 per semester x2 = 758.12: administration fee 50 + student body 14.56 + studierendenWERK 85 + Semesterticket (Deutschlandsemesterticket) 226.80 + social fund 2.70 (TU 'Semester fees' page). History: TU 'Semester fees of previous semesters' page: WS 2025/26 EUR 360.49 (x2 = 720.98); WS 2024/25 EUR 299.35 = 63 + 50 + 9.95 + 176.40 (x2 = 598.70). Winter rate x2 follows the convention used for other Berlin universities in this dataset. No history found. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): There is no year label on the page. The Feb and May 2024 captures fall in the Oct 2023-Mar 2024 application window for the October 2024 intake, so this is the October 2024 intake fee: 15,500 / 2 = 7,750. Same figure in the 2023 captures and in the 2026 rows. There is no year label; the year comes from when the page was captured within the application window. October 2025 intake: 15,500 / 2 = 7,750.

programmes.notes: Master of Space Engineering 'Fees & funding' page: tuition EUR 24,900 for the 2-year programme plus an 'organisation fee of EUR 379.06 per semester' (the WS 2026/27 TU semester fee, so the page is current for 2026 entry; no explicit intake year printed). annualTuition = 24,900 / 2. Compulsory fees = semester fee for winter semester 2026/27, EUR 379.06 per semester x2 = 758.12: administration fee 50 + student body 14.56 + studierendenWERK 85 + Semesterticket (Deutschlandsemesterticket) 226.80 + social fund 2.70 (TU 'Semester fees' page). History: TU 'Semester fees of previous semesters' page: WS 2025/26 EUR 360.49 (x2 = 720.98); WS 2024/25 EUR 299.35 = 63 + 50 + 9.95 + 176.40 (x2 = 598.70). Winter rate x2 follows the convention used for other Berlin universities in this dataset. No history found. Round 7 (2026-10-13, Common Crawl captures of official pages): MSE has one intake a year, in April (application page: 'deadline for the April 2024 intake is 1. October 2023'). April 2024 intake: 24,900 / 2 = 12,450. Compulsory fees follow the WS x2 convention (WS 2024/25 299.35 x2); the page itself lists an organisation fee of EUR 122.95 per semester, without the ticket. April 2025 intake: 24,900 / 2 = 12,450. The fees page has no year label in 2025, but the figure is fixed in the 2022 fee regulations. Compulsory fees use the WS 2025/26 rate x2 (360.49 x2) to follow the convention; the page's own SS 2025 figure is 329.09 per semester.
